item.title: 1 new grant - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 10 Aug 2026 (10 Aug to 16 Aug 2026).

  • Wilson Center Research Fellowship, 2027-2028 Class
    Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 10,000 per month for a twelve-month fellowship, plus covered travel for the two required trips to Washington DC. No application fee.
